mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within 3 months indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals a strengthening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) in a monetary easing cycle leads to increased liquidity and investment in equities, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates inflationary pressures and a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
